Install it with: uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl'; exit 0; }; kmctl briefing || echo '[kmctl] kmctl briefing failed; run kmctl briefing in a terminal to see why, or upgrade with uv tool install --force git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl.'; exit 0

in=$(cat); printf '%s' "$in" | grep -Eq '"executionNum"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*0([^0-9]|$)' || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; cd .. 2>/dev/null && [ -f .agents/hooks/okf-skills/hooks/okf-stop-check.sh ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; out=$(printf '{}' | bash .agents/hooks/okf-skills/hooks/okf-stop-check.sh 2>/dev/null); case "$out" in *'"decision":"block"'*) printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed 's/"decision":"block"/"decision":"continue"/';; *) echo '{}';; esac; exit 0
